description: This is a unit test source file written in C++ that tests the functionality of a template class 'FrameType' with a focus on buffer management, copying, and data access methods. It uses Google Test framework for assertions.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A template class used to handle buffer frames, supporting operations like setting buffers, copying data, reading/writing various data types, and other buffer manipulations.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets a buffer segment of specified type and length at a given offset within the FrameType object.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a buffer segment of specified type and length from a given offset.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Sets or retrieves the size of the frame buffer.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets or clears the frame buffer to its default state.
